questions.prompt: Name a programming, scripting, query, markup or stylesheet language.
questions.scope: Real current and historical computer languages for programs, scripts, database queries, markup or style sheets count. Named dialects also count. Plain data-file formats, code editors and ordinary spoken languages do not count. Named XML vocabularies and document-markup formats count; an organization, generic data model, element or software platform alone is not a language.
questions.rationale: One complete recognizable subject, with actual names, independent familiar-input cases and explicit wrong-category exclusions. Source inventory records, acronym translations and list subsections do not add questions.
